age.evidence: Male C57BL/6 J mice (18-20 g) — only body weight is given, not age

dosing.doses_raw: CRS + psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg); psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg, ip) in AAV experiment
dosing.evidence: Psilocybin, psilocin, and ketamine were dissolved in 0.9% sterile saline solution before use. Psilocybin and ketamine were administered intraperitoneally (ip) in a volume of 10 ml/kg. ... Effects of single injection of psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg, ip)
Effects of single injection of psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg, ip) and ketamine (10 mg/kg, ip)

group_housing.evidence: The male C57 mice were housed in groups of 5 per cage under a 12 h light/dark cycle (note: mice were housed individually for the SPT)

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12 h light/dark cycle at a temperature of 22 ± 2 °C — direction of cycle not stated

assays.assay_description: 40 × 40 × 40 cm open field with 16 floor squares; 5 min video recording analysed by SMART software. CRS experiment: total distance 12 h after psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) or ketamine. AAV astrocyte-depletion experiment: total distance and central-area duration 24 h after psilocybin 2.5 mg/kg.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and ketamine were administered intraperitoneally (ip) in a volume of 10 ml/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: Before testing, the mice were acclimated in the experimental room for 1 h. (room acclimation only, no apparatus pre-exposure)

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were placed separately in the fixed corner of an open-field apparatus (40 × 40 × 40 cm)

time_to_assay.evidence: The OFT was assessed 12 h post-drug administration. ... OFT was performed 24 h after the drug treatments.

sample_size.evidence: Means ± SEM, n = 7 (Fig. 1); Means ± SEM, n = 8-10 (Fig. 4)

outcomes.summary: In CRS mice, psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) and ketamine did not alter total distance 12 h after injection. In the AAV experiment, psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg) increased central-area duration in sham mice (anxiolytic-like), an effect attenuated by PrL astrocyte depletion; total distance was unaffected.
outcomes.statistics: t12 = 0.2798, P > 0.05 (control vs CRS); t12 = 0.7913, P > 0.05 (CRS-veh vs CRS-ket); F(3,24) = 0.1270, P > 0.05 (CRS-veh vs CRS-psilocybin); F(1,28) = 9.106, P < 0.05 (central duration, Sham+Veh vs Sham+Psilocybin); F(1,28) = 9.106, P < 0.01 (AAV depletion effect)
outcomes.evidence: Acute administrations of psilocybin (1.0, 2.5, and 5.0 mg/kg) or ketamine (10 mg/kg) did not show significant impacts on the locomotor activity... Compared with the Sham+Veh group, the duration in the central area was significantly prolonged with single treatment of psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg, ip) (F(1,28) = 9.106, P < 0.05, Fig. 4E)

B1_num_measures.evidence: the total distance (D) and the duration of central area (E) in the OFT

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals over 5 min reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance and central-zone time are spatial measures

B5_social.evidence: The mice were placed separately in the fixed corner of an open-field apparatus

B6_cognitive.evidence: The spontaneous locomotor activity of mice was videotaped for 5 min

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed by SMART video software (position tracking)

E3_bedding.evidence: with 16 identical squares delineated on the floor — no bedding mentioned

E6_spatial.evidence: open-field apparatus with 16 identical squares delineated on the floor

D1_continuity.evidence: The OFT was assessed 12 h post-drug administration. ... OFT was performed 24 h after the drug treatments.

D3_recording_days.evidence: OFT at 12 h (CRS experiment, 7 pm same day) and 24 h post-drug (AAV experiment)

D5_followup.evidence: OFT was performed 24 h after the drug treatments.

assays.assay_description: Individually housed mice trained for 24 h with two bottles (water vs 1% sucrose), water-deprived 24 h, then given both bottles for 8 h (positions swapped after 4 h). Sucrose preference (%) calculated from consumption. CRS mice treated with single psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) or ketamine.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and ketamine were administered intraperitoneally (ip) in a volume of 10 ml/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were housed individually and trained to drink from two bottles containing water or 1% sucrose solution (w/v) for 24 h.

setup_restrain.evidence: the mice were given access to two identical bottles containing water and 1%sucrose solution separately

water_restriction.evidence: The mice were then deprived of water for 24 h.

time_to_assay.evidence: Only 'all behavioral tests were performed at least 12 h after psilocybin treatment'; exact timing of SPT shown only in Fig. 1A schematic

sample_size.evidence: Means ± SEM, n = 7 (Fig. 1 legend); six treatment groups

outcomes.summary: CRS reduced sucrose preference. Single psilocybin at 2.5 and 5 mg/kg (but not 1 mg/kg) and ketamine significantly increased sucrose preference in CRS mice.
outcomes.statistics: t12 = 3.890, P < 0.01 (control vs CRS); t12 = 3.250, P < 0.01 (CRS-veh vs CRS-ket); F(3,24) = 3.884, P < 0.05 (CRS-veh vs CRS-psilocybin)
outcomes.evidence: Compared to the CRS group, both single treatment of ketamine or psilocybin (2.5 and 5.0 mg/kg) performed significant antidepressant effect, increasing sucrose preference in SPT

B1_num_measures.evidence: Sucrose preference was defined as sucrose solution consumption / (sucrose solution consumption +drinking water consumption) ×100%

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The consumption of water and sucrose solution was recorded after the SPT.

B4_ethological.evidence: Preference ratio from bottle consumption only

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate sweet-taste preference, no learning requirement

E1_environment_type.evidence: The mice were housed individually and trained to drink from two bottles... On the test day, the mice were given access to two identical bottles

E8_food_water.evidence: the mice were given access to two identical bottles containing water and 1%sucrose solution separately

D1_continuity.evidence: The positions of the two bottles were replaced after 4 h to avoid place preference, and the test continued for another 4 h. (single uninterrupted 8 h test)

D2_session_duration.evidence: replaced after 4 h ... the test continued for another 4 h (8 h total)

D3_recording_days.evidence: On the test day, the mice were given access to two identical bottles

D5_followup.evidence: Timing relative to dosing not explicitly stated

D6_circadian.evidence: 8 h test (4 h + 4 h) spans >=6 h

assays.assay_description: Clear cylinder (20 cm high, 12 cm diameter), water 24 ± 0.5 °C, 10 cm depth; 6 min swim, immobility scored in last 4 min by two blinded observers. CRS experiment: 1 d and 3 d after psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) or ketamine; AAV experiment: 1, 3, 7 d after psilocybin 2.5 mg/kg.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and ketamine were administered intraperitoneally (ip) in a volume of 10 ml/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were allowed to adapt in the test room for at least 1 h before the test. (room acclimation only)

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were individually forced to swim in a clear cylinder (FST cylinder)

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible in FST cylinder

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were tested in the FST 1d and 3d post-psilocybin injection separately. ... FSTs were performed 1 d, 3 d, and 7 d after the drug treatments, respectively.

sample_size.evidence: Means ± SEM, n = 7 (Fig. 1); Means ± SEM, n = 8-10 (Fig. 4)

outcomes.summary: CRS increased immobility; single psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) and ketamine reduced immobility at 1 d and 3 d. In the AAV experiment psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg) reduced immobility at 1, 3 and 7 d in sham mice, and PrL astrocyte depletion attenuated this effect.
outcomes.evidence: the increased immobility durations were clearly reversed on the first and third days after single administration of psilocybin (1, 2.5 and 5.0 mg/kg) or ketamine ... the immobility durations in FST (1 d, 3 d, and 7 d after the psilocybin treatments) were significantly reduced by psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg, ip) treatment

B1_num_measures.evidence: The duration of immobility was recorded and measured during the last 4 min

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single immobility total for last 4 min

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is excluded by rubric

B5_social.evidence: The mice were individually forced to swim

B7_automated_classification.evidence: measured ... by two observers who were unaware of the treatments

E7_social_context.evidence: The mice were individually forced to swim

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice were tested in the FST 1d and 3d post-psilocybin injection separately; FSTs were performed 1 d, 3 d, and 7 d after the drug treatments

D3_recording_days.evidence: 1 d, 3 d, and 7 d after the drug treatments

D5_followup.evidence: FSTs were performed 1 d, 3 d, and 7 d after the drug treatments

assays.assay_description: Mice food-deprived 24 h, placed in a 50 × 40 × 20 cm white Plexiglas arena with 1 cm sawdust and chow pellets at centre; latency to start chewing/biting recorded within 5 min by two blinded observers. CRS mice treated with single psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) or ketamine.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and ketamine were administered intraperitoneally (ip) in a volume of 10 ml/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were food-deprived for 24 h before the test and acclimated in the experimental room for 1 h. (room acclimation only)

setup_restrain.evidence: Each mouse was introduced into a fixed corner of the testing apparatus and allowed to move freely for 5 min.

food_restriction.evidence: The mice were food-deprived for 24 h before the test

time_to_assay.evidence: Only 'all behavioral tests were performed at least 12 h after psilocybin treatment'; exact timing shown only in Fig. 1A schematic

sample_size.evidence: Means ± SEM, n = 7 (Fig. 1 legend); six treatment groups

outcomes.summary: CRS increased latency to feed; single psilocybin (1, 2.5, 5 mg/kg) and ketamine significantly decreased latency to feed in CRS mice.
outcomes.statistics: t12 = 14.50, P < 0.001 (control vs CRS); t12 = 16.15, P < 0.001 (CRS-veh vs CRS-ket); F(3,24) = 97.30, P < 0.001 (CRS-veh vs CRS-psilocybin)
outcomes.evidence: Acute treatments with psilocybin (1.0, 2.5, and 5.0 mg/kg) or ketamine clearly decreased the latency to feed compared with the CRS group

B1_num_measures.evidence: The latency to start chewing or biting the pellets was recorded within 5 min.

B5_social.evidence: Each mouse was introduced into a fixed corner of the testing apparatus

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate conflict test, no learning requirement

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The latency to feed was evaluated by two observers who were unaware of the treatments.

E1_environment_type.evidence: The apparatus for NSFT (50 × 40 × 20 cm) was made of white opaque nonreflective Plexiglas.

E3_bedding.evidence: The floor was covered with 1 cm of sawdust

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was introduced into a fixed corner of the testing apparatus

E8_food_water.evidence: chow diet pellets of the same shape and size were placed at the center of the apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: allowed to move freely for 5 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to move freely for 5 min

D5_followup.evidence: Timing relative to dosing not explicitly stated

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same 4 behavioural assays (OFT, SPT, FST, NSFT); Western blot, primary astrocyte in vitro work, calcium imaging and immunofluorescence excluded as non-behavioural.
Corrected gemma's B1 scores: 2-3 measures = 1 point (OFT), single measure = 0 points (SPT, FST, NSFT).
OFT collapsed across CRS (12 h) and AAV (24 h) experiments per rubric; scored D1 multiple, D3 2-7, D5 yes, time_to_assay multiple (following deepseek with evidence from Sections 2.5 and 2.15).
setup_habituation set to not_reported for OFT/FST/NSFT because only room acclimation is described; SPT habituation = yes (24 h bottle training).

SPT: 8 h single uninterrupted test scored D2 >6 h and D6 yes (modal); D1 set to Continuous for internal consistency with D2/D6 (candidates split 0/1/2). E1 Home cage (2 of 3 candidates). Water restriction = before (24 h water deprivation).
Time_to_assay for SPT and NSFT set to not_reported: paper only states tests were 'at least 12 h' after dosing, specifics only in Fig. 1A schematic.
Age set to not_reported since only body weight (18-20 g) is given.
Ketamine (positive control) added as a separate dosing entry; psilocin used only in vitro, not included.
n_total left null for OFT and FST because AAV-experiment group sizes are only given as a range (n = 8-10).
